title: Hope Tech RX Stem for Gravel and XC
content:
Hope just updated its beloved RX Stem for 2026, bringing it up to par with modern gravel and XC riding and racing. The RX Stem is designed for gravel and XC riding and now offers an expanded range of lengths to accommodate different bike fits and rider positions. Made in Barnoldswick and available in a spectrum of colors.

Now with a –6° rise in 70mm, 80mm, 90mm and 100mm lengths, as well as the more aggressive, race-focused 80mm –15° rise option.

Available to order through your local Hope dealer.

Roll on over to Hope to check it out.

The post Hope Tech RX Stem for Gravel and XC appeared first on The Radavist.
author: John Watson
